data.name: CR5_A01
data.value: I think we're getting close to the ruins...

data.name: CR5_A02
data.value: We're almost there...[pause=20] According to the map...

data.name: CR5_A03
data.value: ...Is this really it?[pause=20] There's nothing.[pause=10] No fire,[pause=10] no tents.

data.name: CR5_A04
data.value: (Nobody got here before us?[pause=15] But they left first...)

data.name: CR5_A05
data.value: Ah...[pause=20] Plum?[pause=15] How are you doing?

data.name: CR5_A06
data.value: I was just thinking about you...

data.name: CR5_A07
data.value: (...How did she get here?[pause=15] She was way behind us not long ago...)

data.name: CR5_A08
data.value: ...Plum?

data.name: CR5_A09
data.value: The survey was correct.[pause=15] This is the place.

data.name: CR5_A10
data.value: My roots...[pause=20] Next time,[pause=10] someone else carries the supplies.

data.name: CR5_A11
data.value: Nobody sits down before I've checked their feet.[pause=15] That's an order.

data.name: CR5_A12
data.value: You're already here?![pause=20] But we left before you!

data.name: CR5_A13
data.value: The wind comes from the ruins.[pause=15] It smells of nothing.[pause=10] Not even dust.

data.name: CR5_A14
data.value: For once,[pause=10] I'm not last![pause=15] Mark the date.

data.name: CR5_A15
data.value: My legs stopped talking to me.[pause=20] They left at the third pass.

data.name: CR5_A16
data.value: You walked two hours.[pause=15] I carried your bag.

data.name: CR5_A17
data.value: ...and I swear, the ledge gave way RIGHT UNDER MY FEET!

data.name: CR5_A18
data.value: You jumped. I saw you. You jumped before it gave way.

data.name: CR5_A19
data.value: Same thing![pause=15] The danger was REAL!

data.name: CR5_A20
data.value: Kino.[pause=20] Kino, look ahead of you.

data.name: CR5_A21
data.value: She hasn't moved since we arrived...[pause=15] Maybe she walked too far.

data.name: CR5_A22
data.value: Or she's setting something up.[pause=15] She always does that before a prank.

data.name: CR5_A23
data.value: ...Did we do something wrong?

data.name: CR5_A24
data.value: Give her time.[pause=20] Everyone carries exhaustion their own way.

data.name: CR5_A25
data.value: (Since we got here...[pause=15] Plum hasn't said a single word...[pause=20] What's wrong with her?)

data.name: CR5_A26
data.value: YOOOOOOOOU LOOOOOOOOST MEEEEEE!!!

data.name: CR5_A27
data.value: ...We did not lose you.[pause=20] You were not on the expedition roster.

data.name: CR5_A28
data.value: EXACTLY![pause=15] You didn't even LOOK for me!

data.name: CR5_A29
data.value: You can't lose someone you never brought along,[pause=10] Plum.

data.name: CR5_A30
data.value: That's WORSE![pause=20] You lost me BEFORE leaving!

data.name: CR5_A31
data.value: Technically,[pause=10] you arrived before us.[pause=20] We were the lost ones.

data.name: CR5_A32
data.value: ...I took the shortcut.[pause=20] There's a shortcut.[pause=15] You didn't take it.

data.name: CR5_A33
data.value: THERE WAS A SHORTCUT?!

data.name: CR5_A34
data.value: I would have told you![pause=20] IF YOU'D BROUGHT ME ALONG!

data.name: CR5_A35
data.value: (...I think she won.)

data.name: CR5_A36
data.value: So.[pause=20] Do we eat?

data.name: CR5_A37
data.value: Three seconds.[pause=15] He lasted three seconds.

data.name: CR5_A38
data.value: That's a record![pause=15] Yesterday it was two!

data.name: CR5_A39
data.value: I carried the supplies ALL DAY![pause=15] I have every right to—

data.name: CR5_A40
data.value: ...We eat whenever you like.[pause=20] No rush.

data.name: CR5_A41
data.value: (...She didn't even have to speak...)

data.name: CR5_A42
data.value: The fire catches.[pause=20] The camp finally settles in.

data.name: CR5_A43
data.value: Tomorrow,[pause=10] at dawn,[pause=10] we go in.[pause=20] Tonight,[pause=10] we eat and we talk.

data.name: CR5_A44
data.value: ...and the ledge gave way.[pause=15] I STAND BY IT.

data.name: CR5_A45
data.value: He'll stand by it until the world ends.

data.name: CR5_A46
data.value: Here,[pause=10] both of you eat this.[pause=15] You look hollow.

data.name: CR5_A47
data.value: I took the shortcut.[pause=20] I'M well rested.

data.name: CR5_A48
data.value: She's never going to drop this shortcut thing.

data.name: CR5_A49
data.value: The wind died down.[pause=15] First time in three days.

data.name: CR5_A50
data.value: The ruins are split in two.[pause=20] Whatever opened them didn't come from outside.

data.name: CR5_A51
data.value: Then we'll look from the inside.[pause=15] Together.

data.name: CR5_A52
data.value: (It's the first time the whole expedition really talked.[pause=15] That matters.)

data.name: CR5_A53
data.value: Night falls over the camp.[pause=20] Time to sleep.

data.name: CR5_A54
data.value: ...Rin?[pause=15] Are you asleep?

data.name: CR5_A55
data.value: No.[pause=20] But I'm going to pretend.

data.name: CR5_A56
data.value: Hyko,[pause=10] you're already snoring.[pause=15] That's physically impossible.

data.name: CR5_A57
data.value: Reinier.[pause=15] Reinier.[pause=20] It REALLY gave way.

data.name: CR5_A58
data.value: Sleep.

data.name: CR5_A59
data.value: I'm just saying that—

data.name: CR5_A60
data.value: Everyone sleeps.[pause=20] Kino,[pause=10] that includes you.[pause=15] Just like Mount Windswept.

data.name: CR5_A61
data.value: ...Understood.

data.name: CR5_A62
data.value: And nobody wakes up and leaves without me.

data.name: CR5_A63
data.value: Hey...[pause=20] You're not asleep either,[pause=10] are you?

data.name: CR5_A64
data.value: (...No.[pause=15] I'm thinking about tomorrow.)

data.name: CR5_A64b
data.value: Rin,[pause=10] Coco,[pause=10] Kino,[pause=10] Hyko...[pause=20] They followed us all the way here without a single complaint.[pause=0] And tomorrow,[pause=10] we lead them all the way down.[pause=10] That weight,[pause=10] it's heavy,[pause=10] isn't it.

data.name: CR5_A64c
data.value: (It's for them that I'm going down there.[pause=25] So they get a tomorrow worth getting up for.)

data.name: CR5_A65
data.value: Me too.[pause=20] But we got past Mount Windswept.[pause=15] We'll get past this too.

data.name: CR5_A65b
data.value: Whatever we find at the bottom of these ruins,[pause=10] we bring it back up.[pause=15] The two of us.[pause=10] Like always.

data.name: CR5_A66
data.value: Good night.[pause=20] Really.

data.name: CR5_A67
data.value: Good night, everyone.[pause=20] Tomorrow belongs to us.

data.name: CR5_A68
data.value: The next morning...

data.name: CR5_A69
data.value: ...Is it already time?[pause=20] I slept three minutes.

data.name: CR5_A70
data.value: I slept great![pause=15] I dreamt about the ledge.

data.name: CR5_A71
data.value: The bedrolls are packed away.[pause=20] The camp gathers.

data.name: CR5_A72
data.value: Here we are.[pause=20] Three days of marching for this door.

data.name: CR5_A73
data.value: I won't ask you to be brave.[pause=20] I'm asking you to come back.[pause=15] All of you.

data.name: CR5_A74
data.value: Expedition,[pause=10] take point![pause=20] The Aegis Cave are waiting!

data.name: CR5_A75
data.value: Let's go.[pause=20] Stay close to me,[pause=10] okay?

data.name: CR5_A76
data.value: Don't move.[pause=20] You made it back,[pause=10] that's already a lot.

data.name: CR5_A77
data.value: The Ruins pushed you back.[pause=20] Rest.[pause=15] They aren't going anywhere.

data.name: CR5_A78
data.value: You were right to come back up.[pause=20] Forcing it would have led nowhere.

data.name: CR5_A79
data.value: Turning back in time is a decision,[pause=10] not a failure.

data.name: RUINES_TAB_DECOUVERTE
data.value: A standing slab blocks the far end of the chamber.[pause=20] Its surface is hollowed with grooves,[pause=10] each a different shape.

data.name: RUINES_TAB_CAVITES
data.value: The hollows trace familiar silhouettes...[pause=25] Unown.[pause=20] Together they spell a word:[pause=15] {0}.

data.name: RUINES_TAB_MANQUE
data.value: Some grooves are still empty.[pause=20] Still missing:[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: RUINES_TAB_COMPLET
data.value: The stones you carry fit every hollow.[pause=25] The whole slab begins to hum.

data.name: RUINES_TAB_FERMER
data.value: Close your eyes?

data.name: RUINES_TAB_REFUS
data.value: You keep your eyes open.[pause=20] The humming dies away,[pause=10] and the slab is dead stone once more.

data.name: RUINES_TAB_OUVERT
data.value: Where the slab stood,[pause=20] steps descend into darkness.[pause=25] Something below has been waiting a long time.

data.name: RUINES_TAB_FINI
data.value: The three slabs are silent now.[pause=20] Only the pit remains,[pause=15] and whatever sleeps at its bottom.

data.name: RUINES_TAB_PARTENAIRE
data.value: The stairs are right there...[pause=20] Shall we?[pause=15] I'll go first,[pause=10] this time.

data.name: RUINES_PIERRE_TROUVEE
data.value: The Unown fades away...[pause=20] and a carved stone drops where it stood.[pause=25] It bears the shape {0}.

data.name: CRB_REVEL_01
data.value: Open air,[pause=20] all at once.[pause=25] Behind you, the entrance to the ruins is nothing but smooth rock,[pause=20] as though nothing had ever been dug there.

data.name: CRB_REVEL_02
data.value: Look...[pause=20] The cliff split as it closed.[pause=25] There's a way through,[pause=15] up there.[pause=20] It wasn't there this morning.

data.name: CRB_REVEL_03
data.value: (The sanctum sealed itself...[pause=20] and in sealing,[pause=15] it opened something else.)

data.name: CRB_REVEL_04
data.value: A tower of stone rises above the ruins,[pause=25] uncovered by the collapse.[pause=30] Relic Tower is now accessible.

data.name: CR5_A81
data.value: (Her again.[pause=30] And this time,[pause=15] I remember.)

data.name: CR5_A82
data.value: ("Beneath the earth,[pause=15] the silence will know you."[pause=40] What is that supposed to mean?)

data.name: CR5_A83
data.value: (She said I had already explored depths like these.[pause=30] But not with this body.)

data.name: CR5_A84
data.value: You sat bolt upright.[pause=25] Bad dream?

data.name: CR5_A85
data.value: (I can't tell them.[pause=25] Not yet.[pause=30] I wouldn't even know what to say.)

data.name: CR5_A86
data.value: Go back to sleep.[pause=20] Tomorrow,[pause=15] we go down.

data.name: CR5_A87
data.value: Phileas, are you sure?[pause=10] Three days of walking,[pause=10] for this door.[pause=15] It looks... sealed.

data.name: CR5_A88
data.value: It is.[pause=15] But seals are meant to be opened.[pause=0] That is why we are here.

data.name: CR5_A89
data.value: Almotz,[pause=10] you walked with a pack heavier than yourself.[pause=15] I saw you stumble at least four times.

data.name: CR5_A90
data.value: It's the fatigue,[pause=10] not the pack.[pause=15] The pack is light.[pause=10] The road is heavy.

data.name: CR5_A91
data.value: Hyko,[pause=10] your nose has changed since the steppe.[pause=15] You sniff less.[pause=10] You listen.

data.name: CR5_A92
data.value: The wind carries more here.[pause=15] Sounds from the ground,[pause=10] mostly.[pause=0] The steppe,[pause=10] it did not whisper.

data.name: CR5_A93
data.value: Rin,[pause=10] do you think we'll find anything else,[pause=10] in there,[pause=15] besides stone and veins?

data.name: CR5_A94
data.value: I think we find what we bring.[pause=15] Fear,[pause=10] or courage.[pause=0] Let's bring courage.

data.name: CR5_A95
data.value: Almotz,[pause=10] stop eating in secret,[pause=10] everyone can see the bread vanishing.

data.name: CR5_A96
data.value: It's not secrecy.[pause=15] It's foresight.[pause=0] A soldier rations,[pause=10] even in peacetime.

data.name: CR5_A97
data.value: Ganlon,[pause=10] are you asleep?[pause=15] You are already snoring,[pause=10] and the fire is still lit.

data.name: CR5_A98
data.value: Mmm...[pause=20] I keep the fire lit in my sleep.[pause=0] A rare skill.

data.name: CR5_A99
data.value: The last pass was the worst.[pause=15] My legs held,[pause=10] but my heart,[pause=10] it hesitated for a moment.

data.name: CR5_A100
data.value: It's the heart that lasts longest,[pause=10] Penticus.[pause=15] It always finds the road again.[pause=0] Sleep.

data.name: CR5_PHILEAS_REVE
data.value: You had a dream,[pause=10] last night.[pause=15] You told me,[pause=10] when you woke.[pause=0] A silhouette,[pause=10] that knew your name.[pause=15] I don't like dreams that know your name.

data.name: CR5_PHILEAS_REVE2
data.value: The archives below speak of such dreams.[pause=15] They never come alone.[pause=0] And they never stop at a single sleeper.

data.name: CR5_ENTREE_P1
data.value: Phileas.[pause=20] You feel it too,[pause=10] don't you?[pause=15] Last night,[pause=10] he sat up.[pause=0] Not an ordinary nightmare.

data.name: CR5_ENTREE_P2
data.value: I saw it,[pause=10] Penticus.[pause=15] And I heard him murmur a name.[pause=0] The veins,[pause=10] the heat,[pause=10] the storm...[pause=10] and now,[pause=10] this restless sleep.[pause=15] It all converges here,[pause=10] and it tightens my heart.

data.name: CR5_ENTREE_P3
data.value: He has never wavered,[pause=10] not once,[pause=15] since the guild.[pause=0] And this morning,[pause=10] for the first time...[pause=15] he hesitated at the door.[pause=10] That is a good sign,[pause=10] or a bad one.[pause=0] I no longer know.

data.name: CR5_ENTREE_P4
data.value: Keep him in sight,[pause=10] Phileas.[pause=15] And whatever he finds in there,[pause=10] let him know we are here,[pause=10] outside.[pause=0] We followed him this far.[pause=10] We will follow him to the end.

data.name: CR5_ENTREE_P5
data.value: [...] (Phileas and Penticus exchange a glance,[pause=10] then bow toward the entrance.)

data.name: CR5_ENTREE_P6
data.value: Before you go in...[pause=20] one last thing.[pause=15] A rumor I have only trusted to the archives,[pause=10] until tonight.[pause=0] The elders claimed a presence dwelt in these ruins,[pause=10] long before the stone and the guardians.

data.name: CR5_ENTREE_P7
data.value: ...I thought I heard something about Mew?[pause=25] You know someone who would love to hear that.[pause=0] Right?

data.name: CR5_ENTREE_P8
data.value: Plum.[pause=20] We were...[pause=10] discussing the expedition.[pause=0] The stone,[pause=10] not legends.

data.name: CR5_ENTREE_P9
data.value: Indeed.[pause=15] The carvings on the threshold,[pause=10] that is what occupies us.[pause=0] Nothing else.

data.name: CR5_REGISTEEL_01
data.value: He has gone down into the Well.[pause=25] Past the steel.[pause=20] We can no longer see anything from here.

data.name: CR5_REGISTEEL_02
data.value: Three guardians defeated,[pause=10] and he keeps going.[pause=20] Next will be the Colossus itself.

data.name: CR5_REGISTEEL_03
data.value: Then he will not go down alone.[pause=25] Let us go back.[pause=10] If we bring the guild,[pause=10] we will be there when it matters.

data.name: CR5_REGISTEEL_04
data.value: Phileas is right.[pause=15] The camp will stay standing,[pause=10] but we leave to find our people.

data.name: CR5_REGISTEEL_05
data.value: (...) They walk away to the north,[pause=10] and the camp becomes a point in the ruins' night.

data.name: CR5_V01
data.value: And then,[pause=10] the wind ROSE,[pause=15] and I went—[pause=0] "[pause=5] WOOOOSH ![pause=5] "[pause=20] The whole sky howled ![pause=10] And me,[pause=10] calm,[pause=10] right in the middle.[pause=0] "[pause=5] I am the Breath that guards the peak ![pause=5] "

data.name: CR5_V02
data.value: Did you SEE the Breath that guards the peak get taken down by a headbutt?[pause=15] HONESTLY,[pause=10] I would not have done that,[pause=10] even in a dream.

data.name: CR5_V03
data.value: GANLON.[pause=25] That is enough.[pause=20] It is a LEGENDARY,[pause=10] not a scarecrow for your jokes.

data.name: CR5_V04
data.value: But come on,[pause=10] Phileas,[pause=15] we BEAT him ![pause=10] He ran off,[pause=10] and it is us who—

data.name: CR5_V05
data.value: You beat him?[pause=25] NO.[pause=20] You made him give up.[pause=0] And even then.[pause=15] Because HE decided it.[pause=10] Not because you were stronger.

data.name: CR5_V06
data.value: Wait...[pause=20] You mean he could have...?[pause=15] But we saw him stagger,[pause=10] fall to his knees—

data.name: CR5_V07
data.value: He was holding back.[pause=20] Did you see how he flung his gusts at you?[pause=15] Each one reached you,[pause=10] but NONE broke you.[pause=0] A true Tornadus does not aim at the body.[pause=0] It aims at the MOUNTAIN.

data.name: CR5_V08
data.value: And that was not even his true form.[pause=25] The Tornadus of the old texts,[pause=10] the one that splits clouds with a single wingbeat,[pause=15] he never showed himself to us.[pause=0] We saw a contained anger.[pause=10] A warning.

data.name: CR5_V09
data.value: So yes,[pause=10] laugh.[pause=20] Me,[pause=10] tonight,[pause=10] I tell myself one thing :[pause=15] if he had wanted,[pause=10] we would still be halfway up the slope,[pause=10] learning to walk in the wind again.

data.name: CR5_V10
data.value: ...There you go,[pause=15] you scared everyone,[pause=10] Ganlon.[pause=0] Well done.

data.name: CR5_V11
data.value: Hoo...[pause=20] Maybe I went a bit far.[pause=10] But that is why I love these gatherings,[pause=15] you know?[pause=0] The fire,[pause=10] the laughter,[pause=10] and then...[pause=20] a good story to end the day.

data.name: CR5_V12
data.value: Speaking of legends...[pause=20] let me tell you something few know.[pause=0] Sixteen years ago,[pause=15] a hero saved our world.[pause=0] Not a champion,[pause=10] not a king.[pause=10] A simple explorer.[pause=10] Like you.

data.name: CR5_V13
data.value: Sixteen years?[pause=20] But...[pause=15] That is the year when—[pause=10] the great catastrophe?

data.name: CR5_V14
data.value: Exactly.[pause=20] The temporal catastrophe.[pause=15] Time itself had torn apart,[pause=10] and the world was about to sink into it.[pause=0] And facing that,[pause=15] there was only one team.[pause=10] An exploration team.[pause=10] Two Pokemon.[pause=15] And their loyalty to each other.

data.name: CR5_V15
data.value: Only two Pokemon?[pause=20] Against the end of time?[pause=15] That is...[pause=10] that is crazy,[pause=10] right?

data.name: CR5_V16
data.value: That is what a team is.[pause=20] The hero carried the key.[pause=10] His partner carried the faith.[pause=0] And time,[pause=15] which had never bowed to anyone,[pause=20] finally gave way.[pause=0] Before two hearts that refused to let go.

data.name: CR5_V17
data.value: And there was another,[pause=15] you know?[pause=0] A few years earlier.[pause=15] A rescue team.[pause=10] A hero,[pause=10] a partner,[pause=10] and a creature that fell from the sky.[pause=0] Rayquaza.[pause=20] The master of the sky himself allied with them.[pause=0] To stop a star that threatened to crush the world.

data.name: CR5_V18
data.value: Rayquaza ?![pause=20] THE Rayquaza?[pause=15] The jade serpent who lives beyond the clouds?!

data.name: CR5_V19
data.value: Himself.[pause=20] They say that day,[pause=10] the sky spoke.[pause=0] And Rayquaza,[pause=15] who had never answered anyone,[pause=20] answered a team of two strangers.[pause=0] Because they carried within them something he had recognized.

data.name: CR5_V20
data.value: [...] (The fire crackles.[pause=15] No one speaks.[pause=15] Only the wind is heard.)

data.name: CR5_V21
data.value: Come on.[pause=25] Enough chatter.[pause=10] The story is beautiful,[pause=15] but tomorrow we descend.[pause=0] Time to sleep,[pause=10] children.

data.name: CR5_V22
data.value: ...Good night,[pause=10] Phileas.[pause=20] And thank you.[pause=0] For the stories.

data.name: CR5_V23
data.value: Good night.[pause=20] And remember this :[pause=15] the true teams are not the ones who win the most.[pause=0] They are the ones who,[pause=10] the eve of the last day,[pause=10] still tell each other stories around the fire.[pause=15] Sleep well.

data.name: CR5_V24
data.value: (He let us win.[pause=20] No...[pause=10] he let us continue.[pause=0] The difference,[pause=10] tonight,[pause=10] I understand it.)

data.name: CR5_MEW01
data.value: By the way...[pause=20] do you know the rumor about these ruins?[pause=15] They say that long ago,[pause=10] a mythical Pokemon lived here.[pause=0] A small pink creature,[pause=10] elusive.[pause=0] Mew.

data.name: CR5_MEW02
data.value: Mew ?![pause=20] THE Mew?[pause=15] The one who can turn invisible,[pause=10] who remembers every Pokemon?

data.name: CR5_MEW03
data.value: Himself.[pause=20] They say he left an aura behind,[pause=10] here,[pause=10] in the stone.[pause=0] A presence that never quite faded.

data.name: CR5_MEW04
data.value: Is that why the walls seem...[pause=20] alive,[pause=10] sometimes?[pause=15] Why the wind blows for no reason?

data.name: CR5_MEW05
data.value: Perhaps.[pause=20] The elders said that whoever felt it,[pause=10] heard it calling.[pause=0] Without ever knowing where.[pause=15] Maybe that is what you are looking for,[pause=10] without knowing it.

data.name: CRB_REVEL_05
data.value: The ground is shaking![pause=10] What is happening!?
